comments.mergedPostDetails:
A concrete use case:
I open the "New" worlds category and scroll down until I find an interesting world. I go there, and after I'm done, I would like to continue through the list starting from the world I have just visited. But when I open the "New" worlds category again, I have to scroll down again because the previous scroll position wasn't saved.
